about: Outside pages found through Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr) and Llandough property-name searches, together with additional legal sources added through citation research for BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2. Listed URLs are saved to the Internet Archive (Wayback Machine) and saved again every week; this feed does not itself discover every newly issued judgment.

weekly.schedule: Sundays from 03:15 UTC, one page at a time, runs back to back until the list is done
